title: Jets continue to struggle at the ends of halves under Aaron Glenn

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets continue to struggle at the ends of halves under Aaron Glenn
sources.description: The Jets fell to 5-18 under head coach Aaron Glenn with Sunday's loss to the Patriots and their play at the end of the first half loomed large in the loss.
